name: Retirement Nest Egg Calculator
meta_title: Retirement Nest Egg Calculator: How Much Do You Need?
meta_description: Find the nest egg you need from the retirement income you want, other income, inflation and a 4% or other withdrawal rate, plus the monthly saving to reach it.
subtitle: Work out the savings you need on the day you retire from the income you want, using a withdrawal-rate rule such as 4%, and what to save each month to get there.
